cbhNotes.title: What this log is
cbhNotes.body: Prime-Earth / mainline DC from each title's most recent #1, plus All In jump-on issues for books that never relaunched. Absolute Universe books live in the other log.

cbhNotes.title: Most recent #1
cbhNotes.body: Superman, Wonder Woman, Flash, and Green Lantern reset to #1 in 2023. Batman's latest #1 is Matt Fraction's 2025 series. Batgirl, JSA, JLU, Aquaman, GL Corps, Supergirl, and Superman Unlimited got All In or 2025 #1s. Next Level added Lobo, Batwoman, Deathstroke, Firestorm, Zatanna, Teen Titans, Doom Patrol, and Legion in 2026.

cbhNotes.title: Old numbering, All In jump
cbhNotes.body: Action Comics, Detective Comics, Nightwing, Catwoman, Harley Quinn, Poison Ivy, Batman and Robin, Birds of Prey, Green Arrow, Titans / New Titans, and World's Finest kept their numbers. Those start at the All In jump-on issue, not at their 2016-2022 #1.

cbhNotes.title: Events
cbhNotes.body: DC All In Special #1 is the era door. DC K.O. (late 2025 to early 2026) is Act I's finale. Core path: Omega Act Special then K.O. #1-5. Knightfight and the vs. one-shots are optional.

cbhNotes.title: How to read it
cbhNotes.body: Same house rule as the Absolute log: pick a family or follow the list. Mark Read. Write your thoughts. Critic reviews stay locked until you report a Read.
